id.description: A unique identifier for the shipper.

shipperNumber.description: The shipper number associated with a given shipment.

customerId.description: The ID of the customer that is associated with the shipper.

customerAddressId.description: The ID of the customer address that is associated with the shipper.

shipDate.description: The date on which the shipper was shipped.

shippedById.description: The ID of the user who shipped the shipper.

carrierId.description: The supplier ID that is flagged as the carrier on the shipment.

freightTerms.description: Terms of the freight payment; for example, COD, Collect, or Prepaid.

trackingNumber.description: The tracking number, often provided by a carrier, related to a specific shipment.

trailerNumber.description: The trailer number associated with the physical trailer that a specific shipment was shipped on.

note.description: An internal note on the shipper.

scheduledShipDate.description: The date on which the shipper is scheduled to ship.

createdById.description: The ID of the user who created the record.

createdDate.description: The date on which the record was created.

modifiedById.description: The ID of the user who last modified the record.

modifiedDate.description: The date on which the record was last modified.

shipperNote.description: A note to print on the shipper and the bill of lading (BOL).

truckId.description: The ID of the truck associated with the shipper.

expediteReason.description: The reason for expedited shipping as specified on the shipper.

expediteDepartment.description: The department that authorized or required an expedited shipment.

expediteAuthorizedById.description: The ID of the user who authorized the expedited shipping.

expediteAdditionalCost.description: Additional cost due to expedited shipping.

shipFromCode.description: The building code from which the shipper was shipped.

truckArrivalTime.description: This field has been deprecated. Use TruckArrivalTimeOfDay.

printedById.description: The ID of the user who printed the record.

printedDate.description: The date on which the record was printed.

freightAmount.description: Freight amount is the freight cost associated with the shipment.

bolNote.description: The bill of lading (BOL) note on the shipper.

customsExporter.description: The customs exporter specified on the shipper.

deliveryDateTime.description: The delivery date on the shipper.

shipperChargeAmount.description: The charge amount specified on the shipper.

masterBolNo.description: The master bill of lading (BOL) number.

pallets.description: The number of pallets on the shipper.

premiumTransAuth.description: The number specified in the shipper's Premium Trans Auth field (used for AETC numbers on expedited shipments).

truckCalledDate.description: The truck called date. Use format YYYY-MM-DD.

mrn.description: The Movement Reference Number (MRN) specified on the shipper.

mrnDate.description: The movement reference number (MRN) date. Use format YYYY-MM-DD.

pickListPrintedDateTime.description: The date on which the pick list was printed.

truckArrivalTimeOfDay.description: The truck arrival time. Use format hh:mm:ss.
